custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'softness' of the scute lines on the shell. Real turtles have distinct, often raised or grooved lines between scutes. AI images often blend these. Also, verify if the front limb's connection to the body makes anatomical sense or if it appears to 'melt' into the shell. Check if the eye reflection is consistent with the outdoor lighting environment.

Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout, small lateral eyes, and rough, grey-brown skin on the neck and limbs. One front limb is clearly visible, appearing stout with textured skin, though individual toes/claws are partially obscured by the angle and resolution. The plastron edge is visible as a lighter, yellowish-tan color beneath the carapace rim. The background consists of out-of-focus green grass and light-colored rocks.
